findings.problem: A saved asset_search untested=true default was re-injected by an inner tool decorator after the role/coverage schema hid that selector. Documented ordinary asset searches could fail with an untested permission or disabled-coverage error.
findings.fix: The capability-sensitive untested selector now requires an explicit value; its stored default is ignored. Other valid defaults such as limit remain effective. Disabled-coverage DSL instructions no longer say the DSL may be omitted.
findings.regression: TestAssetSearchModeMustBeExplicit: four role/coverage combinations failed before the fix; all pass through direct and deferred calls. Explicit untested requests still require permission and enabled coverage.

findings.problem: The search instructions said to omit state for cross-state deduplication, but an administrator-configured state default still filtered results. Explicit state=empty was also overwritten by default injection, silently hiding queued or historical directions.
findings.fix: context_search applies defaults only to absent fields. Explicit empty q/state/severity remain intact and invalid null values are not converted to valid filters. The fixed Planner guidance and intent-search example use state=empty to remove a configured state filter. Unrelated tools retain their previous default behavior.
findings.regression: TestPlannerSearchExampleClearsConfiguredState initially returned one running intent instead of three. After the fix, omitted state still returns the configured running subset, and the documented example returns open/running/done through direct and deferred calls. TestContextSearchExplicitSelectorsSurviveDefaultInjection also covers null rejection and unrelated defaults.

findings.problem: Merged role schemas listed local and cross-task types/views together without explaining which scope allowed each capability, or when an activity query required intent_id. Roles with no implicit default types were still shown an optional types field.
findings.fix: Parameter descriptions now identify per-scope types, default behavior, activity selectors and reference-specific views. If neither scope has an implicit default search type, the final schema requires types. Existing runtime grants and task isolation are unchanged.
findings.regression: TestContextDocumentationSeparatesLocalAndCrossScope, existing role example execution tests, context selector isolation tests, and Planner migration/scope tests pass.

findings.problem: graph_overview still claimed that Planner received the overview automatically every round.
findings.fix: Its authoritative description now distinguishes the default lightweight bootstrap from an explicitly requested bounded overview; stale stored descriptions cannot replace it.
findings.regression: TestGraphOverviewDocumentationIsOnDemand failed before the fix and passes afterwards.

security_and_behavior_review.old_gate: No executable query ledger, checkPlannerSearch, recordPlannerSearch, beforeCreate callback or search_required error response remains. The remaining search_required text only corrects stale historical instructions or is a negative test assertion.
security_and_behavior_review.no_search_required: Legitimate writes succeed without a query, including when the read-grant set is empty; state-filtered and partial-page searches do not affect admission.
security_and_behavior_review.authorization: Direct and deferred regression cases retain pending/out-of-task rejection, fresh revocation checks, missing/mismatched role/task rejection, manual-mode rejection, per-item success, and no residual rejected intents.
security_and_behavior_review.migration: The previous default prompt hash in the migration was checked against 05c8e90 and matches ab074edd2c859623145f25ca9f5d7ca24d09f3e3eee9e20cf981f702971d7acf. Existing migration idempotence/custom-prompt preservation tests passed; no migration or grant changes were added.
security_and_behavior_review.bootstrap: The 8-record/8000-Unicode-character lightweight bootstrap and dynamic asset revalidation remain in place.
security_and_behavior_review.performance: No extra database queries, automatic searches, model calls or history preloading were introduced. Changes are tool metadata/default handling and regression coverage; no performance or Token reduction claim is made.
